description: This file defines the Goteo\Controller ootTextSubController class, which extends AbstractSubController and manages administrative text translation and editing actions within the Goteo project. It includes methods for listing, editing, translating texts, and handles permissions and form processing.

classes.name: TextsSubController
classes.description: Controller class managing administrative text operations such as listing, editing, and translating targeted at admin users, with custom permission logic overriding and multiple action handlers.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access this controller, restricted to the master node.

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles translation actions for specific text IDs or subactions.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing a specific text item, including form submission and save logic.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles listing of texts based on provided filters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method for processing list, edit, and translate actions, rendering views, and managing form submissions.
